# Privacy and Security Checklist: Contact form sends email instead of storing messages

**Purpose**: Validate that privacy, abuse-control and injection-safety requirements are complete, consistent and measurable for the contact form and API (Constitution V, VII, VIII)
**Created**: 2026-10-10
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist`. Items test the quality of the written requirements, not the implementation.

## Data Minimisation and Logging

- [x] CHK001 Is "no submitted field written to any database, file or log" defined to cover error paths, exception messages and platform observability logs, not only the outcome line? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, §FR-013]
- [x] CHK002 Is the content of the single outcome log line enumerated (fields allowed), so that "outcome only" is unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK003 Are requirements stated for what the email service and Cloudflare Email Routing retain about message content, and does the privacy wording account for that third-party handling? [Gap, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK004 Is the claim "sender's IP address is not stored or used" consistent with what Turnstile verification receives from the request? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012, §FR-014]
- [x] CHK005 Are privacy requirements defined for the lawful basis and consent record, given consent is now only an on-page tick with no stored evidence? [Gap, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK006 Is the retention promise ("only as long as needed", no fixed period) specific enough to be reviewed, and is Don's response time for a deletion request stated? [Measurability, Spec §FR-014]

## Injection and Recipient Control

- [x] CHK007 Are the characters stripped from header-bound values (name, project, reply address) defined precisely, including Unicode line separators and length limits? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK008 Is the visitor's email address validated strictly enough to be used safely as the reply address, and is the rule written down? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK009 Is "only one destination, never from visitor input" stated as an enforced constraint at the platform binding as well as in code? [Coverage, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK010 Is treating the received email body as untrusted data for Don's assistant or any automated reader specified, per the Security Baseline? [Gap, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK011 Is the preview marker requirement protected against spoofing, so a visitor cannot make a production email look like a preview or the reverse? [Gap, Spec §FR-006]

## Abuse Controls

- [x] CHK012 Is the accepted trade-off of no per-sender limit reconciled with Principle VIII and Security Baseline wording that currently require a rate limit, and is the amendment text specified? [Conflict, Spec §FR-012, §Dependencies]
- [x] CHK013 Is there a stated ceiling or monitoring requirement for inbox flooding by sessions that pass Turnstile, or is its absence explicitly accepted? [Gap, Spec §US4]
- [x] CHK014 Are same-origin outcomes for missing, null and mismatched origin consistent between the contract and the story's "no origin information" wording? [Consistency, Spec §US4]
- [x] CHK015 Is the behaviour defined when the email service's own limits are hit by an abuse burst, and is it distinguishable from a generic outage in logs? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK016 Is the trap-field response required to be indistinguishable from a real success in timing and body? [Clarity, Spec §US4]

## Secrets and Retired Endpoints

- [x] CHK017 Is the requirement that retired `/api/messages*` addresses reveal nothing (no auth-dependent difference) measurable for all methods and paths under that prefix? [Measurability, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK018 Is revocation of the old retrieval key handled as a requirement (deadline, owner) rather than only as an optional follow-up? [Gap, Spec §Out of Scope]
- [x] CHK019 Is the assumption that the new binding adds no secret, and that the sender and destination addresses are not secret, stated and validated? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
